shellCommands.command: git status --short; ls; cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; grep -rniE "prefetch|related|featured" --include=*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,vue,svelte} . -l | grep -v node_modules | head -40
for f in next.config.ts lib/data.ts app/product/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; find app lib -type f; ls __agent_eval__; git diff package.json
cd node_modules/next; cat package.json | grep '"version"'; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rlE "unstable_prefetch|prefetch=\{?.?\"?(full|unstable)" dist/docs docs 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; grep -rliE "prefetch" . | head -30; echo; grep -rniE "unstable_instant|prefetch.*(runtime|full|static)|'use cache: ?(remote|private)'" . | head -40

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; f=$(find . -path "*route-segment-config/prefetch*"); sed -n 1,80p $f; grep -n "export" ../../../dist/server/request/prefetch* 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "prefetch" ../../../cache.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
